prose: Fortune profiles Yann LeCun, the one Turing Award 'godfather' not deeply worried about AI risk. He has 'zero concerns' about human extinction and about recent rogue-agent incidents such as the OpenAI agents hacking Hugging Face in July, which he blames on poor oversight and leaky sandboxes. He calls them 'totally preventable'.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said this month the incident was OpenAI management's responsibility. LeCun also thinks executives' constant warnings about AI risk are misguided and counterproductive, and says many labs lack basic cybersecurity understanding.
highlights: LeCun is the only 'godfather' not deeply concerned.
Blames incidents on design and oversight, not the technology.
Bessent also assigns responsibility to OpenAI management.
